en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 15.Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from al-Ḥusayn al-Aḥmasī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “

Paradise will say, ‘O Lord, You filled the Fire just as You promised it, so fill me [as well] just as You promised me!’ So Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, will create a creation and make them enter Paradise.”
Then Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) said, “Blessed are they, for they [shall] neither [have] witnessed the sorrows of the world nor its worries.”
